app/bubble-width.ts.reason: CSS fit-content and text-wrap cannot hug the widest wrapped line while preserving its line breaks.

app/chat-app.tsx.reason: Existing UI lifecycle or geometry; retire or justify under the UI retirement epic.

app/chat-opening.ts.reason: use-stick-to-bottom exposes position, not app renderer readiness or reserved composer room before history is revealed.

app/chat-surface.tsx.reason: Element.scrollIntoView is one-shot; an opening history-row target must survive late reply and composer layout.

app/composer-layout-height.ts.reason: CSS cannot interpolate auto-to-auto composer/chip height; Vercel's textarea sizing only covers the field.

app/drawer-swipe.ts.reason: UI SDK 0.1.0-beta.3 cannot swipe open from chat; Base UI 1.9 SwipeArea leaves it open on touch cancellation.

app/kept-chat.tsx.reason: use-stick-to-bottom defers resize following by a frame; saved history must stay at its end on every paint.

app/late-boxes.ts.reason: CSS has no cross-visit diagram-size memory or streaming maximum; Streamdown supplies neither.

app/motion.ts.reason: Existing UI lifecycle or geometry; retire or justify under the UI retirement epic.

app/page.tsx.reason: Existing UI lifecycle or geometry; retire or justify under the UI retirement epic.

app/reading-hold.ts.reason: CSS anchoring suppresses adjustment at scrollTop=0; use-stick-to-bottom does not prepare app-paginated history.

app/rotation-reading.ts.reason: Native rotation anchors on the header; use-stick-to-bottom cannot transfer free reading.

components/plotly-chart.tsx.reason: Plotly's responsive mode re-lays a figure out at its frame's size; a figure drawn at a fixed width and scaled like an image needs the frame's width as it changes.

components/ui/sheet-height.ts.reason: CSS cannot interpolate auto-to-auto size; Base UI has no resize animation, and UI SDK beta.2 translates content snaps without interpolating box height.
